newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Chariot Holdings buys QSV for 16 mln rand.
newsitem.headline: Chariot Holdings buys QSV for 16 mln rand.

text.p: Chariot Holdings Ltd on Wednesday said it had purchased the business of engine spares importers and distributers QSV Motor Spares and QSV U-Joint Centre in a deal worth around 16 million rand.
Chariot also said in a cautionary announcement that it was involved in further negotiations for further acquisitions which could have an effect on share prices.
The acquisition of QSV was in line with the company's objective to expand its core business of automotive related distribution, the company said.
It said the QSV deal gave Chariot an entry into the largest sector of the South African vehicle parts market -- estimated last year to be worth 5.8 billion at retail level.

The deal would be conducted at three levels and will be settled by an initial issue of 10.9 million Chariot shares, followed by an issue of 7.5 million shares if QSV achieved a net after tax profit of 2.83 million rand in the year to April 1998.
The company said a further consideration would be paid if QSV exceeded a net after tax profit of 2.83 million.
